title: EpixChain v0.7.0 — cosmos/evm v0.7 (Krakatoa, BlockSTM, virtual fees, ibc-go v11)
summary:
## EpixChain v0.7.0 Upgrade

This upgrade brings EpixChain up to date with the upstream cosmos/evm v0.7.0 release. The current mainnet binary is labelled `epixd v0.5.5` on the Epix side but is built from the upstream cosmos/evm v0.6.x codebase, so this single upgrade telescopes both the v0.5.5 → v0.6 work that was rolled into the Epix v0.5.5 release and the v0.6 → v0.7.0 transition.

### What's changing

#### Performance / consensus

- **Krakatoa application-layer mempool** — moves the EVM mempool out of CometBFT and into the application layer. The chain gets full control over mempool semantics: nonce-aware ordering, replace-by-fee, eviction policy, and the ability to reject txs at admission time without waiting for `CheckTx`. Replaces v0.6's `ExperimentalEVMMempool`.
- **BlockSTM parallel execution** — parallel state-transition function under a software-transactional-memory scheduler, with per-tx object stores for bloom / log indexing / gas accounting and an incarnation cache for signature/auth verification.
- **Virtual fee collection** — `EndBlock` fee settlement via a per-tx bank object store. Required by BlockSTM and only safe on 18-decimal chains (EpixChain qualifies).
- **Optimistic execution** — the baseapp speculatively executes the next block during `ProcessProposal`, so when `FinalizeBlock` arrives most of the work is already done. Composes with Krakatoa and BlockSTM.

#### Dependency stack

- cosmos-sdk **v0.53 → v0.54**
- cometbft **v0.38 → v0.39**
- ibc-go **v10 → v11**
- geth fork **v1.16 → v1.17**
- Go **1.24 → 1.25**

#### Modules

- **`x/precisebank` removed.** The module wrapped `x/bank` to bridge 6-decimal cosmos denoms (like Cosmos Hub's `uatom`) into the EVM's 18-decimal world. EpixChain's native `aepix` denom is already 18 decimals, so the wrapper is unnecessary — its store has a zero remainder on-chain right now. The store key is pruned at the upgrade height by `StoreUpgrades.Deleted`.
- **`x/ibc/transfer` override removed.** The fork-local override of the upstream transfer module is gone; the upstream version is now sufficient.
- **EVM params backfill.** `Params.HistoryServeWindow` is a new field in v0.7 that controls the EIP-2935 history buffer size. The upgrade handler backfills it to the upstream default (8192) on the existing params row so history-serving RPCs (`eth_getBlockByHash` at depth, `BLOCKHASH` opcode against older blocks) keep working post-upgrade.
- **EVM coin info re-init.** The on-disk `evmCoinInfo` row is rebuilt from the live bank denom metadata so the v0.7 virtual fee collector reads a fresh, correct row (display denom + 18-decimal exponent) on the first post-upgrade tx.

### Risk assessment

The upgrade is **consensus-breaking** — every validator must run the v0.7.0 binary at the upgrade height or fork off the network. Beyond standard upgrade risk:

- The precisebank store deletion is irreversible. We've verified on-chain that the store has a zero remainder, so no user-owned value lives there.
- BlockSTM + virtual fees materially change the per-block execution path. Throughput should improve on contended blocks (multiple independent txs in flight); single-tx latency is unchanged.
- The mempool replacement (Krakatoa) means tx admission semantics differ from the v0.6 mempool. Wallets and indexers that interact with the mempool should be regression-tested.

### Validator action checklist

1. Pull the v0.7.0 release binary: `https://github.com/EpixZone/EpixChain/releases/tag/v0.7.0`
2. Verify the binary checksum against the release notes.
3. Have the v0.7.0 binary staged on every validator host **before** the upgrade height.
4. Use Cosmovisor or your equivalent automation — at the upgrade height the running v0.5.5 binary will halt and the v0.7.0 binary must take over.
5. Monitor block production for the first few blocks post-upgrade; the BlockSTM runner emits structured logs for any retries.
6. Anyone running an RPC node should restart it to pick up the new `eth_*` history-serving behavior.

### Timeline

- **Proposal posted:** see chain time
- **Voting period:** 7 days (per current gov params)
- **Upgrade height:** 3,925,000 — approximately 14 days after the proposal passes (at 6-second blocks)
